title: 频谱柱阵 / Spectrum columns
author: Rhythm Master

descriptions.en-US: A batched field of up to 4096 columns responds to the spectrum. Change grid density, span and camera framing independently of the final background.
descriptions.zh-CN: 最多 4096 根批量绘制的立柱响应频谱。独立调整点阵密度、分布跨度和相机取景，不绑定最终背景。
